units.source_text: 她的头略微倾侧，向帘外闲眺，姿态美丽无比。

en.t: Her head was tilted slightly as she gazed idly beyond the curtain, and her bearing was incomparably beautiful.

units.source_text: 她的发髻和颜貌酷肖源氏公子所恋慕的藤壶母后，妩媚动人。

en.t: Her coiffure and features closely resembled Lady Fujitsubo, whom Prince Genji so longed for, and her charm was deeply alluring.

units.source_text: 对槿姬的恋慕之情便收了几分回来。

en.t: His longing for Princess Asagao was drawn back a little.
Just then, he suddenly heard the cry of mandarin ducks.
Prince Genji then composed a verse on the spot:
